text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days after announcing our challenge to take on both the Yasuda Kinen and Takarazuka Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...There's an inquiry directed to the academy, you say?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's mostly directed at you, Trainer,
but there are voices asking to hear more
about the recent announcement...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
One look at social media makes it easy to guess.
They're just looking for a convenient excuse to denounce the Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: "...Dragging the academy into this goes against my aesthetic. Here, I shall hold another press conference—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Tanino Gimlet has already proven herself enough through her running. The one falling short is me.
choice_data_list: This is where I have to show my resolve.
This is where I have to show my resolve.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Targeting the Yasuda-Takarazuka rotation with Tanino Gimlet.
What is required of me as a Trainer to achieve it.
I laid everything bare.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: There is only one way to do it...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"...You seem to have an idea.
Very well, I shall follow it."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And on the day of the press conference—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
—Gim-senpai!?
Wh-Why are you here?!
Didn't you have a press conference today...—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's true.
...Well, that's a trivial matter.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...More importantly, Vodka.
What's up with you?
—Looks like there's something you wanna ask me.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ngh...—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Aren't you scared, Senpai?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Even when people talk about my challenges like they are now... or, well... even when facing massive hardships...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: How can you... smile right now...?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Vodka. The press conference is about to start.
Care to watch it with me?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I stand alone before the rows of reporters.
From here on out, this is the real test.
choice_data_list: Thank you all for gathering here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After giving that greeting, she looked into the
reporters' eyes and began to weave her words...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—What I explained was the reason Tanino Gimlet and I
are running the Yasuda-Takarazuka rotation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To achieve a feat even greater than the MC Rotation."
That is Tanino Gimlet's and my goal.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And that the stages chosen after discussing with her
to achieve that were the Yasuda Kinen
and the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I solemnly explain the plain, unvarnished truth just as it happened. And then—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: —Tanino Gimlet actually got injured during the MC rotation, didn't she? Did you properly take that into consideration?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: "—You say you discussed it with her, but shouldn't it have been your duty as her Trainer to stop her?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Questions and comments poured out from the reporters in waves.
Listening carefully to each and every one—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I accepted it all first.
After all, as her Trainer, I have the responsibility to protect her future.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And on top of that.
choice_data_list: I will take responsibility and support Tanino Gimlet

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The talent Tanino Gimlet has displayed is so precious and dazzling that it causes this many people to worry.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Still, that's precisely why—
I want to continue supporting Tanino Gimlet's talent,
her aesthetic, and her challenges."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If she wishes to shine even brighter, then as her Trainer, I want to support that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to just protect that talent...
I want to write a scenario together with you that will make it shine even brighter.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Because doing so will surely burn the name
of Tanino Gimlet deep into the hearts of many once more—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And above all,
because Tanino Gimlet herself desires it."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Because I am by her side and in a position of responsibility,
I must possess greater resolve than anyone, stake everything to support,
cheer on, fight together, and make her dream come true."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That is————
my resolve, and my way of being as Tanino Gimlet's Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
...Then, in the worst-case scenario,
are you saying you will take full responsibility?
choice_data_list: Of course, I'm staking my entire life on this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even before that, though————
choice_data_list: I will make sure this challenge is a success.

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: (Murmur, murmur, murmur...)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Bwahahaha!!! Did you see that,
Vodka?! Everyone's completely speechless!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...I-Incredible...
What kind of guts does that person have...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Quite so.
——Truly mad, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
That is why they are...
my one and only Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Vodka, let me answer your question from earlier.
"Aren't you scared?"
"How can you smile like that?" That was it, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The answer is simple.
We have long since resolved ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Truly————like one possessed.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"...I suppose I should be going soon.
I want to show him some appreciation."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—You can look forward to
the battle history we will forge from here on.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
The seniors have completely made up their minds
to walk their own paths, huh—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"That's why nothin' scares me.
Not headwinds, not adversity, not a damn thing...!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: SO FREAKIN' COOOOOL!!!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
What an idiot I am!
Why didn't I realize it?!
Of course... they were prepared for this all along!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Me too...!!
Someday... I gotta find the resolve
to walk my own path...!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the night following the solo press conference—

text_block_list.name: A Certain Social Media Platform
text_block_list.text:
"‘Hearing them step forward and say it was all their
responsibility was a bit of a relief.
I'm sure things are tough, but maybe I'll cheer them on.’"

text_block_list.name: A Certain Social Media Platform
text_block_list.text:
"Well said, Trainer!!
I can really tell how much you care about Gimlet!! Good luck to both of you!"

text_block_list.name: A Certain Social Media Platform
text_block_list.text:
""Since you've said this much, I might as well see it through.
I want to see Gimlet's great feat myself, after all.""

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh. It seems the words born from your soul have intoxicated quite a crowd.
choice_data_list: ...I merely declared what needed to be done.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
That steadfast purity is a form of madness in itself, is it?
How splendid. However—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Among those you have intoxicated,
do not forget that I am one of them, understood?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Your conduct was truly magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: As someone who walks alongside you... I couldn't be prouder.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: From here on out, I shall move forward alongside Tanino Gimlet with unwavering resolve.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With a fresh mindset, the journey toward the Yasuda Kinen had begun—
